result.summary: The page is mostly intact, with one clear defect: the round button in the top-right of the header shows only an empty grey circle with a red notification dot. Its icon (likely a bell or cart) is missing. The carousels, cards, promo banner and bottom navigation look as intended.

issues.description: The circular button at the top-right of the header (next to the delivery address) has no icon. Only the light grey circle and a red badge dot are rendered, so its purpose (notifications, cart, etc.) cannot be determined.
issues.suggestion: Restore the missing icon glyph inside the button. Check that the icon asset or font loads correctly and that the icon colour is not matching the background. Add an accessible label to the button as well.
